Routed by [ADR-0158](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/docs/adr/0158-units-of-measure-standard-unit-table-org-units-quantity-unit-declaration-base-quantity.md#open-items), Open item 5, to R2's card (write-time base-quantity projection). Parent: #35339 (ADR merged in PR #35370, 35bd36082c).

## Question (the ADR's text)
When an old row's quantity is edited and its unit is unchanged, does R2 reuse the row's stored factor? The record's 1A pulls two ways: "affects later writes only" (the maintainer's pick 「可改，只影响以后」) against "they change only through an explicit recompute" (the seat's settlement). Whichever R2's card picks is a reading of 「可改，只影响以后」.

## Done when
R2's card states the rule for an edited old row (reuse the stored factor, or take the current ratio), pins it, and ADR-0158 is amended.

## Grade
p3 · area:data · domain:server. R2 has no card yet and follows R1; no row is wrong today.
